text:
marco (partnerships): Quick kickoff thread for the NimbusCompute + LangChain + OrchX marketplace bundle. Need to align on: marketplace SKU copy, SI enablement checklist, supported client versions, and a coordinated announce cadence with Nimbus.

leah (marketing): Thanks. Marketing wants a one-line product blurb, 3 bullets (perf / cost / compliance), and a screenshot or GIF for the listing. Can we lock perf numbers and a demo flow by Wed?

rafael (eng-runtime): We ran end-to-end flows on Nimbus rtx-v2 and OrchX scheduler. End-to-end median latency for chat (seq 256) is ~72ms, throughput ~700 tokens/s under steady state. Caveat: these numbers assume prefix caching enabled.

marco (partnerships): Good. Tina, can you confirm the adapter wiring for LangChain and LlamaIndex? Docs need exact code snippet for customers.

tina (solutions): Adapter mapping is stable. Supported LangChain: 1.5+ (tested up to 1.7). LlamaIndex: we map node->chunk and expose chunk_id in metadata. Sample YAML for OrchX gateway in docs: 
```yaml
adapter: redwood-nimbus-lc
langchain_version: "1.6"
llamaindex_mapping: 
  chunk_key: chunk_id
  index_schema: /path/to/index_schema.json
orchestrator: orchx://default
cache: prefix_enabled: true
```
Include that in the quickstart.

jacob (sales): Pricing ask: Nimbus wants a marketplace-visible MSRP and a partner discount tier. Also need a short battlecard: when to recommend hosted vs Dedicated on Nimbus.

rafael (eng-runtime): For MSRP bullets, use: p50 72ms (seq256), p99 180ms; tokens/sec 700. For Dedicated on Nimbus, COGS delta ~1.6x vs hosted due to reserved GPU costs (ballpark). I'll pull exact numbers from infra cost sheets tomorrow.

leah (marketing): Partner preview window requested by Nimbus: 36h. They also want a co-branded demo video available during preview. We have to confirm embargo + partner quote.

marco (partnerships): Proposed plan: partner preview 36h, internal freeze 12h before public, public launch + marketplace listing, then 48h monitoring blackout (no other marketing pushes). Does that align with teams?

tina (solutions): Works for SI scheduling. We'll run two 1hr enablement sessions in the 24h preview window for top SIs. Add a troubleshooting matrix for OrchX failures (auth, routing, KV eviction).

ci-bot: build: marketplace-bundle/nimbus-lc-orchx succeeded (artifact: nimbus-lc-orchx-v1.tar.gz)

rafael (eng-runtime): Note: OrchX router requires a small connector config change for request pinning. Add this snippet to the playbook: `pin_to_node: true` and `max_shards: 4`. Otherwise routing falls back to lowest-cost path and increases tail latency.

jacob (sales): Can we get a one-pager battlecard by Friday? I'll need objection handling for data residency (customers ask about logs on Nimbus), plus short comparison chart vs competitor X.

leah (marketing): I'll draft listing copy: "Redwood + LangChain Adapter on NimbusCompute (OrchX-ready)  GPU-accelerated inference, low-latency chat, SI-ready deployment." Need final perf confirm and a screenshot.

marco (partnerships): Action items: Rafael  perf artifact + COGS numbers; Tina  playbook + adapter YAML; Leah  marketplace copy + demo GIF; Jacob  battlecard draft; Marco  coordinate Nimbus quote + embargo. Sync call Friday 9am PT.

tina (solutions): I'll attach sample `index_schema.json` and a short troubleshooting checklist to the docs PR today. Also adding OrchX healthcheck endpoint example: `GET /_orchx/health?adapter=redwood-nimbus-lc`.

rafael (eng-runtime): Uploading perf traces now to build artifact store. Also adding the OrchX pin config to the default deployment template.

leah (marketing): Marking calendar. If Nimbus confirms co-brand assets today we can cut the demo video this afternoon.

jacob (sales): Heads-up: enterprise AE flagged a prospect in EMEA who needs a GDPR data flow diagram for Nimbus Dedicated. Tina/rafael can you help with a redlined diagram?

tina (solutions): Yup, will produce a redline and host on the design share.

marco (partnerships): Great. If no blockers, we proceed with partner preview on 1765563600. Post any blockers here before the sync.
